description: Pavement – Sidewalk is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. This dataset geographically displays information about sidewalk data from the County Road Administration Board (CRAB) GIS-Mo database. GIS-Mo database replaced the old Mobility database. Please read the metadata ( for additional information. Any data download constitutes acceptance of the Terms of Use (. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The portal files it under the category Maps and Geospatial. Its tags are road measures, mobility, pierce county roads, sidewalk, roads. The table has 26 columns. The portal shows 2026-06-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
